description: Krutrim's Bhashik speech-to-speech translation: upload a short English audio file and receive synthesized speech in the target Indic language as a download link.

meta.api_language_codes: tgt_lang_code: eng, guj, ben, hin, kan, mal, mar, tam, tel
meta.output: data.audio_file download URL of translated synthesized audio

name: Bhashik Speech-to-Speech Translation

description: Krutrim's in-house Indic speech recognition model (Bhashik), with short-file sync and long-form async transcription.

meta.api_language_codes: eng, guj, ben, hin, kan, mal, mar, tam, tel
meta.endpoints: POST https://cloud.olakrutrim.com/api/v1/languagelabs/transcribe/upload (short); POST /languagelabs/transcribe/lf/upload (long, async, poll /languagelabs/job_status/{request_id}); POST /languagelabs/stt_trans/upload and /stt_trans/lf/upload (speech translation, source eng only)
meta.pricing_note: Billed per minute/hour of audio in INR; rates shown only in the Krutrim Cloud console

name: Bhashik Speech-to-Text

description: Krutrim's in-house Indic text-to-speech model (Bhashik) with male and female speakers; returns a download link to the audio file.

meta.api_language_codes: eng, guj, ben, hin, kan, mal, mar, tam, tel
meta.endpoints: POST https://cloud.olakrutrim.com/api/v1/languagelabs/tts; POST /languagelabs/tts_trans (translate eng text then synthesize)
meta.pricing_note: Billed per minute/hour of audio in INR; rates shown only in the Krutrim Cloud console

name: Bhashik Text-to-Speech
